messages:
ana: Auditor requested SOC2/ISO evidence tying RBAC changes to KMS activity. Need role list, approvers, CloudTrail ops, key policy, rotation manifest. looping @auditor_jess.

mike: I'll pull PRs, JIRA IDs, approvals and export CloudTrail for alias/ri-inference-prod-wrap.

liz: rotation happened 2025-03-10T03:12Z. james can attach rotation manifest and key-policy diff.

james: attached manifest (checksum + signer) and policy diff to JIRA-SEC-3421.

auditor_jess: Provide CloudTrail records for GenerateDataKey/Encrypt/Decrypt on the key ARN, rolebinding snapshots before/after, and a 1-page mapping of artifacts to controls. Mask emails but keep ARNs.

ops-bot: Upload checklist: private ACL, SSE-KMS, lifecycle tag soc2-evidence/2025-Q1, include ticket link in metadata.

mike: uploaded kms-cloudtrail.csv and svc-activity for svc/ingest-processor to s3://redwood-audit-buckets/soc2/2025-03/. ACL and SSE-KMS set.

liz: ran rolebinding snapshot job: prod changed 4 bindings (svc/ingest-processor updated), staging 12 changes, no external principals added. uploaded snapshots.

auditor_jess: Good. Also attach vuln-triage note for JIRA-SEC-3421 confirming no risky remediation. Once you upload a 1-page narrative linking artifacts to SOC2/ISO controls we can close.

ana: I'll assemble the one-pager and evidence bundle and update the auditor ticket when uploaded. :rocket:
